contracts: unknown is never promoted to free without ray evidence
terminal hits are not cleared and cells behind a hit remain unknown
static and dynamic evidence are separated
collision is the conservative union of structural and semantic occupied states
dynamic decay returns transient occupancy to UNKNOWN, not observed free
correlated same-batch log-odds updates are capped per cell
invalid or stale batches cannot partially mutate the mapper
each committed non-empty batch or decay receives one atomic map_version
snapshot arrays are copied and validated

mathematical_profile.measurement_model: bounded additive log-odds with prior zero

limitations: The structural mapper currently consumes normalized 2D ray evidence; P2 deskew and frame adapters remain upstream.
Persistence is represented by bounded log-odds and explicit dynamic decay; production memory profiles still require approval.
No physical sensor, blind-zone or hardware calibration claim is made.
